# Better Result Home Tuition SEO Setup

Primary website URL: https://www.betterresulthometuition.com

## Central SEO configuration
Edit `src/lib/seo.js` to update page titles, descriptions, keywords, canonical paths, and social metadata.

Every public route has a small `layout.js` that reads its metadata from the central configuration. Keep the route key in `PAGE_SEO` aligned with its URL.

## Automatically generated routes
- `/robots.txt` is generated by `src/app/robots.js`.
- `/sitemap.xml` is generated by `src/app/sitemap.js`.
- `/manifest.json` is served from `public/manifest.json`.

## Important deployment checks
1. Ensure the production domain is configured in Vercel and `www` is the primary domain.
2. Ensure `https://betterresulthometuition.com` redirects to `https://www.betterresulthometuition.com`.
3. After deployment, check `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/manifest.json`, and page source metadata.
4. Add Google Search Console verification only after obtaining the actual verification token. Do not invent a token.
5. Add real social profile URLs to the `sameAs` array in `src/app/layout.js` only when official profiles are available.

## SEO limitations
Metadata and technical SEO improve crawlability and page presentation; they do not guarantee rankings. Search performance also depends on useful original content, local business accuracy, site performance, backlinks, and Search Console monitoring.
